Bonjour, je voudrais résumer le rapport trimestriel et vérifier les délais de livraison pour l'usine de Montréal, s'il vous plaît.

The migration programme moved into its second phase at the start of October, with the global trade workstream reporting steady progress against the plan. Security role design remains the critical path: the team identified that several hundred roles need to be rebuilt rather than converted, and the additional effort has been absorbed into the schedule without moving the go-live date. Data migration rehearsals completed two full cycles with error rates below the threshold agreed with the business, and the remaining defects are concentrated in two object types that the functional teams already understand well. Cutover planning has started earlier than in previous programmes, on the explicit lesson that the quiet weeks before go-live are never quiet, and that the time is better spent rehearsing the fallback procedures nobody hopes to use.
